command:
set -eu
echo SNAPSHOT_BEGIN
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
date -u +%s
echo PROCESSES
ps -eo pid,comm | awk '$2 ~ /^(AVOC|deviced|dotnet|vlog|trace-cmd)$/ {print}'
echo TRACING
for p in /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_on /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/available_tracers /proc/sys/kernel/kptr_restrict /proc/sys/kernel/perf_event_paranoid; do
if test -r "$p"; then echo "$p"; cat "$p"; fi
done
echo CHECKPOINT_CAPABILITIES
for p in /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/kprobe_events /sys/kernel/tracing/kprobe_events /proc/kallsyms /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/uprobe_events /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/instances; do
if test -e "$p"; then stat -c '%F %a %n' "$p"; else echo "ABSENT $p"; fi
done
echo FAULT_LOG_TAIL
dmesg | awk '/ERR DET Status|GetErrDetStatus|RT Protect|m_set_power_control|QDFTcon_SetQdTconPowerControl/ {a[n%60]=$0;n++} END {s=n>60?n-60:0;for(i=s;i<n;i++)print a[i%60];print "MATCH_COUNT",n+0}'
echo SNAPSHOT_END
owner_state: asleep; left panel off via For You; no live visual observer
scope: metadata and existing ring log only
